title: Canonicalize triggers test fixture root (Windows 8.3, follow-up to wcpf-1)
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/triggers/mod.rs worktree_fixture (~line 523), canonicalize the tmp root with dunce::canonicalize (fallback to_path_buf) before building main/wt, same pattern as wcpf-1. Fixes Windows-only red store_path_resolves_to_control_root_from_a_linked_worktree: .bee/triggers does not exist so n() falls back to the raw spelling and long-vs-8.3 forms diverge at mod.rs:549.
goal: Windows CI verify green on windows-latest; Linux suite stays green.
notes: Surfaced by CI run 31945914659 after wcpf-1 fixed the first 4; trigger tests first reached Windows CI in that push.
